summary: Iteration 34 — Production Readiness Audit + Quarantine + Analytics tested on live preview. 11/13 backend pytest cases PASS. Production audit runs, returns production_ready=true, active_production_buyers=10718, quarantined_total=4, quarantine_reasons populated, compliant_sources includes eu_ted+cid_canada+sam_gov+uk_companies_house, shared_apis note present, and /app/memory/VBIE_PRODUCTION_AUDIT.md is written. Audit without X-Admin-Token → 401. Quarantine effective: public GET /api/buyers/meta.total (10718) equals active_production_buyers; search returns no junk names (no 'N/A' / 'Test_Test' / '.'). QA audit overall_pass=true, no sample_records. Analytics JSON returns all required keys (today_buyers, this_week, this_month, total_active=10718, new_countries list of 31, new_industries list, top_products/corridors/sources/sectors/countries) and 401 without token. Analytics XLSX 200 + spreadsheet ct. Exports xlsx+pdf 200. DELETE soft-deletes; public GET → 404. PATCH persists (sector updated in DB) and API says admin_edited was set. Frontend: /buyers renders 10718 buyer cards, buyer-sources-section visible, nav-notif-bell opens nav-notif-panel with 'New verified buyers added' notification. Buyer profile /buyers/:geid unauth shows buyer-source-warning banner + buyer-paywall. TWO BUGS: (1) public GET /api/buyers/{geid} does NOT include last_verified field (also missing primary_source/source_warning in the top-level keys actually source_warning+primary_source ARE present — only last_verified is missing) → the [data-testid=buyer-last-verified] element is NOT rendered on the buyer profile page (0 in DOM). (2) admin_edited flag not exposed on public GET response (PATCH internally sets it — updated:['sector','admin_edited','updated_at'] — but the public serializer does not expose admin_edited).

critical.issue: Response does NOT include 'last_verified' field for unauth (or auth) — required per spec so frontend can render buyer-last-verified. vbie.py _full is supposed to include last_verified but the served payload has: geid, legal_name, display_name, country, country_name, city, sector, products, hs_families, corridors, size, role, trust, evidence_count, sample, locked, lock_reason, website, provenance, signals, status, primary_source, source_warning — no last_verified.

minor.issue: admin_edited field not present in public serializer response. PATCH /api/buyers/admin/{geid} returns updated:['sector','admin_edited','updated_at'] confirming DB write, but downstream GET does not expose admin_edited so UI cannot indicate 'Admin edited' badges.
Text search still does not index geid (carry-over from iteration 33). q=<geid> returns 'Buyer not found'.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid=buyer-last-verified] not rendered because backend does not return last_verified for the buyer. Element count in DOM = 0.

action_items: Include 'last_verified' in the public /api/buyers/{geid} response (vbie.py _full — verify field is actually returned; if buyers lack it, ingestion should backfill last_verified=first_seen or updated_at).
Expose 'admin_edited' (and optionally 'updated_at') in the public buyer detail serializer so the UI/tests can verify admin edits externally.
(Nice-to-have) Add geid to admin ?q= search fields (also in iter33 report).
